hypotheses.justification: hn follows from hqn : ¬ (q:ℕ) ∣ n. If n = 0 then (q:ℕ) ∣ 0 (dvd_zero), contradicting hqn, so n ≠ 0 and hence 0 < n. (hα also gives it: α^0 = 1 = (q:ℂ-bar) is impossible since q ≥ 2 in characteristic 0.) hn is not mentioned in any other binder or in the conclusion. The proof only needs it in `Nat.mul_pos hn hd`, `zero_pow hn.ne'`, `NeZero n` and `hn.ne'`. Inside the proof, derive it first with `have hn : 0 < n := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (fun h => hqn (h ▸ dvd_zero _))`. The rest of the proof is unchanged, so the theorem is true and provable without the argument.
